runtimeArgs: const h=require('http'),f=require('fs'),p=require('path');const r=process.cwd();const t={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.svg':'image/svg+xml','.png':'image/png','.json':'application/json'};h.createServer((q,s)=>{let u=decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]);const x=p.resolve(p.join(r,u));if(!x.startsWith(r)){s.writeHead(403);return s.end()}f.readFile(x,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('not found')}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':t[p.extname(x)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(d)})}).listen(5188)
